issues.issue: Was the adjudicator's decision to exclude the LP-04 position from the bargaining unit under FPSLRA 59(1)(g) unreasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Adjudicator unreasonably interpreted FPSLRA narrowly and relied improperly on incumbent's seniority and experience.
issues.respondent_position: Adjudicator's broad interpretation of 59(1)(g) was reasonable; seniority comments addressed employer's delegation argument.
issues.result_text: Court disagrees with applicant's submissions, finds adjudicator's interpretation reasonable.
